assessments.reasoning: The commit-pinned SPDX original identifies release 3.29.0 through creatoragent/3_29_0. The ListedLicense deprecation flag is false. All six field digests match, including the header with its original comma spacing. The header and comment resolve the shorter label's potential ambiguity about Cover Texts.

challenge.method: Compared a complete 1.2-or-later notice declaring no features with the same notice designating one Front-Cover Text, an unavailable notice, and a notice confined to 1.2 with all three features absent.
challenge.results: The complete feature-free or-later notice meets both conditions. A single Cover Text defeats the all-absent condition even with zero Invariant Sections. An unavailable notice supplies no evidence of absence. A 1.2-only notice meets the feature condition but fails the edition condition, even though GNU's sample includes later-version wording.

limitations: Absence can be assessed from a complete authorized notice because section 1 defines these features through designation. Missing notice text leaves their status unknown. The SPDX example cannot supply a missing grant.
